# Avrasya Properties Group (Avrasya Properties)
> Trusted luxury real estate investment consultancy & Turkish Citizenship by Investment advisory desk in Istanbul, Türkiye.

## Core Services
1. **Independent Buyer's Real Estate Advisory**: Curated residential and commercial property investments across European and Asian corridors of Istanbul (Beşiktaş, Maslak, Şişli, Kadıköy, Topkapı, Ataşehir).
2. **Turkish Citizenship by Investment (CBI)**: Full legal due diligence and portfolio structuring exceeding the statutory $400,000 threshold under Law No. 5901.
3. **Legal Due Diligence**: Title Deed (Tapu) registry clearance, appraisal report coordination (SPK-licensed), and Foreign Exchange Certificate (DAB) processing with the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye.
4. **Acquisition Cost Calculation**: Accurate modeling of 4% title deed transfer fee, 1%–20% VAT (with foreigner exemption under Law No. 3065), legal fees, and translation expenses.
